summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a 6-K with a press release reporting periodic share purchases under its €250 million second tranche of a €3.5 billion multi-year buyback program announced April 10, 2026, to run through 2030. Daily purchases on Euronext Milan show 11,966 shares at an average €335.14 per share for €4.01 million. Since tranche start, €187.4 million was invested for 620,677 EXM shares and €40.8 million (€35.2 million) for 118,319 NYSE shares. Treasury held 1,514,061 shares, 0.85% of issued shares. Buybacks continue as planned; watch cadence and capital return pace.
